title: Enrolment
description: The POST to <url>/.well-known/qory-enrolment, which assigns a new access key its id, its 201 answer and its signed refusals: the request's body is $defs/request, the answer's $defs/answer, a signed 409's or 429's $defs/refusal, and a document is one of the three. The request carries no access key id and no request signature; the code and the proof authenticate it. The answer and every signed refusal are signed under the server's key, the first line of the signed answer being the enrolment answers' own domain line, qory-enrol-answer-ed25519-v1, and line 3 the request's proof exactly as sent. The server checks the key and verifies the proof under it before it signs anything. The answer and every signed refusal list the server's keys, so a machine without a pin verifies either under the key its code's first fingerprint names. A member the schema does not define is refused, and so is a member name twice in one object. Every binary value is base64url without padding.

server_keys.description: The server's signing keys: the current one, and during a rotation the next one after it. The machine verifies the answer or the refusal under the entry whose fingerprint the code carries first, and from a 201 pins only the entries whose fingerprints the code carries.

request.title: Enrolment request
request.description: The body of the enrolment request. proof is the Ed25519 signature under the new key of five lines joined by a line feed, with none after the last: qory-enrol-ed25519-v1, code, public_key, name, and timestamp in canonical decimal.

version.description: The document format. A server refuses another version, 400 invalid_request.

code.description: The enrolment code in its normalised form: qec_ and 26 Crockford base32 characters in upper case, then a dot and the fingerprint of the server's public key, and during a rotation of the server's key a second dot and the next key's fingerprint. A fingerprint is base64url(SHA-256(raw public key)[:16]).

name.description: The access key's name for people, by default the host name of the machine that enrols it.

public_key.description: The new access key's raw Ed25519 public key.

timestamp.description: The machine's clock, in decimal seconds since the Unix epoch. The server accepts it within 300 seconds of its own. It is a JSON integer below 2^53, with no sign, fraction or exponent; the server checks the form when it decodes.

proof.description: The proof of possession: the Ed25519 signature, 64 bytes, under the new key.

answer.title: Enrolment answer
answer.description: The 201 answer: the new access key's id, its node or node pool, its stored-secrets flag and the server's public keys. The access key is active from the 201 on. Every member is required.

version.description: The document format. Forager refuses a version it does not read.

access_key_id.description: The access key's id: ak_ and 16 lower-case Crockford base32 characters.

node_id.description: The id of the access key's node, nd_, or node pool, np_, followed by 16 lower-case Crockford base32 characters.

node_kind.description: node for an nd_ id, pool for an np_ id.

stored_secrets.description: The access key's stored-secrets flag, fixed when the key is created.

refusal.title: Enrolment refusal
refusal.description: The body of a signed 409 or 429 at enrolment: key_invalid, a 409 for a key already enrolled, a revoked one included; key_limit, a 409 for a node or node pool that already holds two keys; or rate_limited, a 429 per code, for too many attempts with one code. It lists apiary_public_key, the same list in the same order as a 201 at that moment, current key first and during a rotation the next key after it, so the machine verifies the refusal as it verifies the 201: under the entry whose fingerprint its code carries first. A refusal sent unsigned, the 401, the 409 key_invalid to a key the checks refuse or a proof that does not verify under it, and every answer before the code is accepted, lists no key, and a machine acts on none by its status.

names.description: The names the refusal concerns, when it concerns any.
